module.name: API Users
module.description: Locked-down SIP accounts (internal / external / 911 / international + extension whitelist) that only work through the Kamailio gateway. Managed here or from the remote Docker panel (with safety lock).
module.changelog: *17.2.0* Example addresses like 10.x.x.x:5070 are refused in Settings and never reach share cards *17.1.1* One portal login can own several phones (one account per phone); plain-language family setup guide (docs/family-setup.md) *17.1.0* E-mail alerts, user portal, dashboard colors (reach number, type colors, live-call and danger highlights) *17.0.4* Tabs: Dashboard grid, Users, Sign-in history, Failed sign-ins, Audit log; bulk delete; reconnect blips merged *17.0.3* Per-user conference rooms and feature codes (feature codes: PBX page only) *17.0.2* Live view: signed-in phones, calls in progress + hang up, sign-in history, failed sign-ins *17.0.1* Initial release
